description:
Michael Fanous believes data is the foundation of every great AI model.

When people think about companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Meta, they often focus on the AI itself.

But behind every powerful model is an enormous amount of training data.

Michael says understanding and organizing data is just as important as building the model.

His message is simple:

AI is only as good as the data it learns from.

The companies that master data will have the biggest advantage in the AI era.
